question: Who is the author of the book 'School to Startup: Navigating the Path of Entrepreneurship'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohit Sinha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Rohit Sinha** is the author of the book *'School to Startup: Navigating the Path of Entrepreneurship'*.
 
• The book provides insightful guidance for aspiring entrepreneurs, particularly students, on transitioning from academic life to entrepreneurial ventures.
 
• It emphasizes the challenges and opportunities involved in building startups and navigating the entrepreneurial ecosystem.
 
• The book highlights key strategies for innovation, funding, team-building, and scaling businesses successfully.
 
• It serves as a motivational and practical resource for young minds looking to explore entrepreneurship as a career path.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Romila Thapar**

 
 
• Romila Thapar is a renowned Indian historian specializing in ancient Indian history.
 
• Her notable works include *'A History of India'* and *'Early India: From the Origins to AD 1300'*.
 
• She has contributed extensively to the study of social and political structures in ancient India.
 
 
 
• **Bipin Chandra**
 
 
• Bipin Chandra was a prominent historian of modern Indian history.
 
• His famous books include *'India's Struggle for Independence'* and *'The Rise and Growth of Economic Nationalism in India'*.
 
• He focused on India's freedom movement and socio-economic developments during British rule.
 
 
 
• **Shashi Tharoor**
 
 
• Shashi Tharoor is a well-known Indian politician, diplomat, and author.
 
• His notable books include *'Inglorious Empire: What the British Did and What India Lost'* and *'Why I Am a Hindu'*.
 
• He writes extensively on history, politics, and international relations.
